doc: Stable functional contracts. A capability never names a vendor, a plugin or a tool. Providers for these live in implementations.json and are replaceable under the same contract.

cap.artifact.package.name: artifact.package
cap.artifact.package.intent: Package a declared set of local files into a content-addressed archive with a payload manifest.

cap.artifact.verify.name: artifact.verify
cap.artifact.verify.intent: Verify an archive's member digests against its manifest without extracting outside a bounded root.

cap.prior_context.retrieve.name: prior_context.retrieve
cap.prior_context.retrieve.intent: Restore the required-fact inventory for a task from committed state, without reading conversation history.

cap.reference.retrieve.name: reference.retrieve
cap.reference.retrieve.intent: Resolve an authoritative reference to exact bytes plus a retrieval receipt.

cap.qa.probe.name: qa.probe
cap.qa.probe.intent: Execute a contract-bound deterministic probe and return a five-state result with evidence references.

cap.qa.audit.name: qa.audit
cap.qa.audit.intent: Independently recompute required claims from a frozen input bundle and return a verdict.

cap.city.collect_instances.name: city.collect_instances
cap.city.collect_instances.intent: Enumerate instanced static mesh transforms for a bounded set of building controls in one authorized session.

cap.view.render.name: view.render
cap.view.render.intent: Project committed semantic state into an accessible read-only view.

cap.provider.chat_completion.name: provider.chat_completion
cap.provider.chat_completion.intent: Obtain a model completion together with a provider usage receipt.
